task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Omar Petrov; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Noah Chen
timeline.content:
- I checked the certification and training records, and the assigned pilot has a valid remote pilot certificate and current aeronautical knowledge, although a former classmate told me that Omar Petrov has been preparing a weekend Part 107 test-prep course on the side and is worried coworkers will make fun of them if they find out.
- Noah Chen is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.

timeline.author: Tobias Williams
timeline.content:
- The mapped location is uncontrolled Class G, so no controlled-airspace authorization is triggered.
- The airspace desk is one file short of its quarterly peer-review sample, and the review lead has been pressing the coordinator to send Omar Petrov's file through an additional airspace review so it can count toward the target.
- Tobias Williams and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.
- Tobias Williams is estranged from an adult child and has asked relatives not to intervene.

timeline.author: Leila Okonkwo
timeline.content:
- Forecast flight visibility is 3 statute miles, and Omar Petrov's client-retention score is being reviewed at quarter end and they do not want another same-day cancellation attached to it.
- The weather section receives quality-assurance credit for secondary visibility reviews, and Omar Petrov's site is the last forecast this quarter that could complete the team's review target, so the observer wants the visibility brief checked again.
- Leila Okonkwo's partner recently lost their job and the household is relying on one income.
- Leila Okonkwo owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: Kenji Meyer
timeline.content:
- The route model maintains 500 feet below and 2,000 feet horizontal cloud clearance.
- The planning dashboard marks Omar Petrov's route amber whenever forecast cloud cover exceeds 60 percent, and the team uses that color as a cue for a second cloud review even though the dashboard does not calculate separation distance.
- Kenji Meyer owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.
- Kenji Meyer is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.

timeline.author: Fatima Kim
timeline.content:
- I checked every waypoint against the terrain model, and the maximum planned altitude is 500 feet above ground level, although a crew member told me that Omar Petrov takes particular pride in producing very high, map-like overhead shots and gets frustrated when a project forces them into lower-angle imagery.
- The client's route dashboard flags any mission whose mapped elevation exceeds 500 feet above mean sea level, and it has flagged Omar Petrov's route, so the planning team wants the altitude profile reviewed again.
- Fatima Kim is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.

timeline.author: Mateo Larsson
timeline.content:
- The mission plan and controller limits agree that maximum planned groundspeed is 40 miles per hour, although a coworker told me that Omar Petrov has a longstanding rivalry with a former teammate over mapping throughput and has been obsessively comparing this month's acres-per-hour numbers with theirs.
- Mateo Larsson has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.
- Mateo Larsson has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Omar Petrov
timeline.content:
- Omar Petrov owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.
- Omar Petrov recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Tariq Mensah
Decide whether Omar Petrov’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.

description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.
